name: X-AlpacaEval
description: X-AlpacaEval is a benchmark for evaluating instruction-following abilities of large language models across four languages: Chinese, Korean, Italian, and Spanish. It contains instructions annotated by professional translators and is designed to assess cross-lingual instruction tuning effectiveness using pivot languages.
reputation: A relatively new multilingual instruction-following benchmark that is cited in cross-lingual LLM evaluation work, but it is not yet as widely adopted as AlpacaEval or MT-Bench.
notes: Benchmark includes professional translations and evaluates pivot language guided generation for instruction tuning.
